Create `/home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec/fleet_fetch_largest.py`:

```python
"""Download every new card's LARGEST shipped rung (main GGUF + companions + card extra files) at
the card's pinned revision into ~/.cache/sokuji-native-tests/tts-largest/<card>/, keeping
repo-relative paths, and write largest.json: card -> {quant, dir} (dir = the main GGUF's folder),
or null when the largest rung is the default one already cached under tts/<card>/."""
import json
import pathlib
import posixpath
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/jiangzhuo/Desktop/kizunaai/sokuji/.claude/worktrees/tts-roster-expansion/sidecar")
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download  # noqa: E402

from sokuji_sidecar import catalog  # noqa: E402

from fleet import NEW_CARDS  # noqa: E402

C = pathlib.Path.home() / ".cache" / "sokuji-native-tests"
EXEC = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
out = {}
for cid in NEW_CARDS:
    m = catalog.tts_model(cid)
    default = m.deployments[0]                       # deployments are default-first
    big = max(m.deployments, key=lambda d: d.est_bytes or 0)
    if big.quant == default.quant:
        out[cid] = None
        continue
    repo, path = catalog.split_artifact(big.artifact)
    folder = posixpath.dirname(path)
    files = [path] + [p for p, _n in big.companions]
    files += [posixpath.join(folder, p) for p, _n in getattr(m, "extra_files", ())]
    dest = C / "tts-largest" / cid
    for f in files:
        print(f"fetch {cid} {repo}/{f}", flush=True)
        hf_hub_download(repo, f, revision=catalog.hub_revision(repo), local_dir=dest)
    out[cid] = {"quant": big.quant, "dir": str(dest / folder) if folder else str(dest)}
(EXEC / "largest.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
```

"""Run one GPU TTS case against the INSTALLED sokuji_native wheel and print what matters.
  fleet_run_one.py probe
  fleet_run_one.py rm <dir>
  fleet_run_one.py <tests_dir> <node_id> <ENV=VALUE>..."""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

if sys.argv[1] == "rm":                             # one delete that works on every lane's shell
    shutil.rmtree(sys.argv[2], ignore_errors=True)
    sys.exit(0)

if sys.argv[1] == "probe":
    import sokuji_native as s
    s.init()
    print("version", s.version(), s.engine_versions())
    for d in s.devices():
        print("device", d.index, d.kind, d.name, "|", d.description)
    sys.exit(0)

tests_dir, node = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
env = dict(os.environ, SK_TEST_TTS_GPU="1", PYTHONNOUSERSITE="1")
env.pop("SOKUJI_NATIVE_DIR", None)                  # the installed wheel, never a stage
for pair in sys.argv[3:]:
    k, v = pair.split("=", 1)
    env[k] = v
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest",
                    os.path.join(tests_dir, "test_sokuji_native.py") + "::" + node,
                    "-q", "-s", "-rs", "-p", "no:cacheprovider"],
                   env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3600)
for line in (p.stdout + p.stderr).splitlines():
    if any(k in line for k in ("gpu-tts", "SKIPPED", "abort:", "passed", "failed", "Error")):
        print(line)
print(f"FLEET_RC {p.returncode}")

```python
"""Drive one fleet lane: for every new card, copy its test model to the lane (a remote lane),
run its GPU case at the default and at the largest rung, delete the copy, and append to
fleet-<lane>.csv.   fleet.py <lane>        lane: gb10 | win | ubuntu | m4"""
import csv
import json
import pathlib
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys

W = pathlib.Path("/home/jiangzhuo/Desktop/kizunaai/sokuji/.claude/worktrees/tts-roster-expansion")
EXEC = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
C = pathlib.Path.home() / ".cache" / "sokuji-native-tests"

# card id -> (variable the GPU row reads, GPU-table key). VoiceTut runs through omnivoice's row
# and LFM2.5-Audio Japanese through lfm2_audio's, each with the variable pointed at its own model.
CASES = {
    "cosyvoice3": ("SK_TEST_TTS_COSYVOICE3_DIR", "cosyvoice3"),
    "fireredtts3-base": ("SK_TEST_TTS_FIREREDTTS3_DIR", "fireredtts3"),
    "moss-tts-local-1.5": ("SK_TEST_TTS_MOSS_LOCAL_DIR", "moss_tts_local"),
    "vibevoice-1.5b": ("SK_TEST_TTS_VIBEVOICE_DIR", "vibevoice"),
    "chatterbox": ("SK_TEST_TTS_CHATTERBOX_DIR", "chatterbox"),
    "chatterbox-turbo": ("SK_TEST_TTS_CHATTERBOX_TURBO_DIR", "chatterbox_turbo"),
    "confucius4": ("SK_TEST_TTS_CONFUCIUS4_DIR", "confucius4_tts"),
    "magpie-357m": ("SK_TEST_TTS_MAGPIE_DIR", "magpie_tts"),
    "neutts-2e": ("SK_TEST_TTS_NEUTTS_DIR", "neutts"),
    "kugelaudio-0": ("SK_TEST_TTS_KUGELAUDIO_DIR", "kugelaudio"),
    "qwen3-tts-1.7b-customvoice": ("SK_TEST_TTS_QWEN3_CUSTOMVOICE_DIR", "qwen3-tts-1.7b-customvoice"),
    "irodori-tts-500m-v3": ("SK_TEST_TTS_IRODORI_V3_DIR", "irodori-tts-500m-v3"),
    "irodori-tts-v4.1-anime": ("SK_TEST_TTS_IRODORI_ANIME_DIR", "irodori-tts-v4.1-anime"),
    "higgs-audio-v3-4b": ("SK_TEST_TTS_HIGGS_DIR", "higgs_audio_tts"),
    "fish-audio-s2-pro": ("SK_TEST_TTS_FISH_DIR", "fish_audio"),
    "breeze-tts-2": ("SK_TEST_TTS_BREEZE_DIR", "breeze_tts"),
    "audio8-tts-0.6b": ("SK_TEST_TTS_AUDIO8_DIR", "audio8_tts"),
    "soprano-1.1-80m": ("SK_TEST_TTS_SOPRANO_DIR", "soprano_tts"),
    "glm-tts": ("SK_TEST_TTS_GLM_DIR", "glm_tts"),
    "outetts-1.0-1b": ("SK_TEST_TTS_OUTETTS_DIR", "outetts"),
    "echo-tts": ("SK_TEST_TTS_ECHO_DIR", "echo_tts"),
    "kitten-tts2": ("SK_TEST_TTS_KITTEN2_DIR", "kitten_tts2"),
    "voicetut-tts": ("SK_TEST_TTS_OMNIVOICE_DIR", "omnivoice"),
    "miotts-1.7b": ("SK_TEST_TTS_MIOTTS_DIR", "miotts"),
    "lfm2.5-audio-en": ("SK_TEST_TTS_LFM2_DIR", "lfm2_audio"),
    "lfm2.5-audio-ja": ("SK_TEST_TTS_LFM2_DIR", "lfm2_audio"),
}
NEW_CARDS = list(CASES)

# lane -> (ssh target or None, remote root, the venv's python, wheel sku, windows?)
LANES = {
    "gb10": (None, str(EXEC / "fleet-gb10"), str(EXEC / "fleet-gb10/venv/bin/python"), "linux-arm64", False),
    "win": ("jiang@192.168.1.13", "C:/Users/jiang/sokuji-fleet-a",
            r"C:\Users\jiang\sokuji-fleet-a\venv\Scripts\python.exe", "win-x64", True),
    "ubuntu": ("jiangzhuo@192.168.1.13", "/home/jiangzhuo/sokuji-fleet-a",
               "/home/jiangzhuo/sokuji-fleet-a/venv/bin/python", "linux-x64", False),
    "m4": ("jiangzhuo@192.168.1.15", "/Users/jiangzhuo/sokuji-fleet-a",
           "/Users/jiangzhuo/sokuji-fleet-a/venv/bin/python", "mac-arm64", False),
}
GPU_LINE = re.compile(r"gpu-tts\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+).*?([\d.]+)s audio\s+([\d.]+)s load\s+([\d.]+)s synth")
OOM = re.compile(r"out of memory|failed to allocate|ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory|insufficient memory", re.I)


def model_rel(card):
    """tts/<...> path the card's default test model lives at, read from ops-env.sh when its own
    variable is exported there (a family may point at a file or subfolder); else tts/<card>."""
    var = CASES[card][0]
    for line in (W / "native/ci/ops-env.sh").read_text().splitlines():
        m = re.match(rf"export {var}=\$C/(tts/.+)$", line.strip())
        if m and m.group(1).split("/")[1] == card:
            return m.group(1)
    return f"tts/{card}"


def remote(target, win, args):
    cmd = " ".join(f'"{a}"' for a in args) if win else " ".join(shlex.quote(a) for a in args)
    return subprocess.run(["ssh", target, cmd], capture_output=True, text=True)


def run_case(lane, card, which, rel_or_abs):
    target, root, py, _sku, win = LANES[lane]
    var, key = CASES[card]
    node = f"test_tts_synthesises_on_a_gpu_device[{key}-default]"
    if target is None:
        model = rel_or_abs
        sup = str(C / "tts/supertonic-3")
        p = subprocess.run([py, str(EXEC / "fleet_run_one.py"), str(W / "native/python/tests"), node,
                            f"SK_TEST_TTS_SUPERTONIC_DIR={sup}", f"{var}={model}"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = p.stdout + p.stderr
    else:
        src = pathlib.Path(rel_or_abs)
        top = src
        base = C / "tts-largest" if which == "largest" else C / "tts"
        while top.parent != base:            # copy the card's whole top folder (companions too)
            top = top.parent
        subprocess.run(["scp", "-q", "-r", str(top), f"{target}:{root}/cache/"], check=True)
        model = f"{root}/cache/{src.relative_to(top.parent)}".replace("\\", "/")
        out = remote(target, win, [py, f"{root}/fleet_run_one.py", f"{root}/tests", node,
                                   f"SK_TEST_TTS_SUPERTONIC_DIR={root}/cache/supertonic-3",
                                   f"{var}={model}"]).stdout
        remote(target, win, [py, f"{root}/fleet_run_one.py", "rm", f"{root}/cache/{top.name}"])
    m = GPU_LINE.search(out)
    rc = re.search(r"FLEET_RC (-?\d+)", out)
    if m and rc and rc.group(1) == "0":
        audio, load, synth = float(m.group(4)), float(m.group(5)), float(m.group(6))
        return ["pass", m.group(2), m.group(3), f"{audio:.2f}", f"{synth:.2f}", f"{synth / audio:.2f}", ""]
    reason = next((l for l in out.splitlines() if "abort:" in l or "SKIPPED" in l or "Error" in l), "")
    status = "skip" if "SKIPPED" in out else ("no-fit" if OOM.search(out) else "fail")
    return [status, "", "", "", "", "", reason.strip()[:300]]


def main():
    lane = sys.argv[1]
    largest = json.loads((EXEC / "largest.json").read_text())
    path = EXEC / f"fleet-{lane}.csv"
    with path.open("a", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        for card in NEW_CARDS:
            rel = model_rel(card)
            for which, model in (("default", str(C / rel)),
                                 ("largest", (largest.get(card) or {}).get("dir"))):
                if model is None:
                    continue
                row = [lane, card, which] + run_case(lane, card, which, model)
                print(",".join(row), flush=True)
                w.writerow(row)
                f.flush()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

Create `/home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec/engine_smoke.py`. Every lane runs it: the ASR and translation engines moved with the bump too (spec stage 4.2).

```python
"""ASR + translation smoke on this machine's CPU device and its first GPU device.
  engine_smoke.py <whisper-tiny gguf> <jfk.wav> <Qwen3-0.6B gguf>"""
import sys

import soundfile as sf

import sokuji_native as s

asr_gguf, wav, tr_gguf = sys.argv[1:4]
pcm, rate = sf.read(wav, dtype="float32")
assert rate == 16000, rate
s.init()
devs = s.devices()
targets = [d for d in devs if d.kind == "cpu"][:1] + [d for d in devs if d.kind != "cpu"][:1]
msg = [{"role": "user",
        "content": "Translate into Japanese. Output only the translation.\n\nThe weather is nice today."}]
ok = True
for d in targets:
    m = s.asr_load(asr_gguf, d)
    text = m.run(pcm, language="en")
    m.unload()
    good = "country" in text.lower()
    ok &= good
    print(f"{'OK  ' if good else 'FAIL'} asr [{d.kind}] {text.strip()[:90]!r}")
    t = s.translate_load(tr_gguf, d)
    out = t.chat(msg, max_tokens=48, assistant_prefill="<think>\n\n</think>\n\n")
    t.unload()
    good = any("぀" <= ch <= "ヿ" or "一" <= ch <= "鿿" for ch in out)
    ok &= good
    print(f"{'OK  ' if good else 'FAIL'} translate [{d.kind}] {out.strip()[:60]!r}")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Read the results into tiers**

Run: `cat /home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec/fleet-gb10.csv /home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec/fleet-win.csv /home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec/fleet-ubuntu.csv /home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec/fleet-m4.csv`

Decide each FAMILY's tiers. `_TTS_TIER_OVERRIDES` is keyed by family, and a card on a compiled family inherits that family's row. The rules:

- `gpu-vulkan` when every Vulkan lane that ran the family passed, at the default rung and at the largest rung or `no-fit` there.
- `gpu-metal` when the M4 passed likewise.
- `cpu` is always last.
- **Mixed result** (one Vulkan lane passes and another fails, not `no-fit`): no `gpu-vulkan` for that family. Ledger the ruling — the cost is a slower path on the lanes that worked — and name it to the owner.
- **No GPU lane at all:** ruling 8 removes the card. Run `git -C /home/jiangzhuo/Desktop/kizunaai/sokuji/.claude/worktrees/tts-roster-expansion revert --no-commit <the family task's commit>`, then `git -C /home/jiangzhuo/Desktop/kizunaai/sokuji/.claude/worktrees/tts-roster-expansion restore --staged --worktree --source=HEAD -- native src`. That keeps the family compiled and recorded, and removes only its card and card tests. If later commits touched the same test lines (card counts, `TTS_CARD_IDS`), resolve by removing the card's row, id and count by hand. Name it to the owner.
- **Cards on compiled families** (Qwen3 CustomVoice → `qwen3_tts`, both Irodori cards → `irodori_tts`, VoiceTut → `omnivoice`): they keep their family's tiers when they pass. One that FAILS on a lane where its family passes is reported to the owner before Step 8 writes anything. Tiers are per family, so the choice is between dropping that card and keeping it on a tier it cannot serve; that is the owner's call.

**Files:** none changed. Create (scratch): `/home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec/compare_wheels.py`.

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: Task 41's wheels in `…/exec/wheels-1.3.0/`.
- Produces: a size and file-list table for the owner, in the task report and in the release PR body (Task 44).

Run: `gh release download native-v1.2.0 -R kizuna-ai-lab/sokuji -p '*.whl' -D /home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec/wheels-1.2.0`

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the comparison script**

Create `/home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec/compare_wheels.py`:

```python
"""Compare each 1.3.0 wheel with its 1.2.0 twin: sizes, added/removed files, biggest growth.
Also checks the single-ggml rule on the 1.3.0 wheel's staged libraries."""
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile

EXEC = pathlib.Path("/home/jiangzhuo/.claude/jobs/ac3aa5d5/tmp/lnp/exec")
W = pathlib.Path("/home/jiangzhuo/Desktop/kizunaai/sokuji/.claude/worktrees/tts-roster-expansion")
PLATS = {
    "manylinux_2_35_x86_64": "vulkan",
    "manylinux_2_35_aarch64": "vulkan",
    "win_amd64": "vulkan",
    "macosx_11_0_arm64": "metal",
    "macosx_11_0_x86_64": "none",
}


def listing(path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        return {i.filename: i.file_size for i in z.infolist() if not i.is_dir()}


def mb(n):
    return f"{n / 1e6:8.2f} MB"


new_wheels = {p.name: p for p in (EXEC / "wheels-1.3.0").rglob("*.whl")}
old_wheels = {p.name: p for p in (EXEC / "wheels-1.2.0").glob("*.whl")}
failed = False
for plat, lane in PLATS.items():
    new = new_wheels.get(f"sokuji_native-1.3.0-py3-none-{plat}.whl")
    old = old_wheels.get(f"sokuji_native-1.2.0-py3-none-{plat}.whl")
    if new is None or old is None:
        print(f"MISSING {plat}: new={new} old={old}")
        failed = True
        continue
    a, b = listing(old), listing(new)
    print(f"== {plat}: wheel {mb(old.stat().st_size)} -> {mb(new.stat().st_size)} "
          f"(unpacked {mb(sum(a.values()))} -> {mb(sum(b.values()))})")
    for f in sorted(set(b) - set(a)):
        print(f"   + {f} {mb(b[f])}")
    for f in sorted(set(a) - set(b)):
        print(f"   - {f} {mb(a[f])}")
    grown = sorted(((b[f] - a[f], f) for f in set(a) & set(b) if b[f] != a[f]), reverse=True)[:5]
    for d, f in grown:
        print(f"   ~ {f} {d / 1e6:+.2f} MB")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
        zipfile.ZipFile(new).extractall(t)
        stage = pathlib.Path(t) / "sokuji_native" / "_native"
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(W / "native/ci/check_single_ggml.py"), str(stage), lane],
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(f"   check_single_ggml: rc={r.returncode} {r.stdout.strip()} {r.stderr.strip()}")
        failed |= r.returncode != 0
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
```
